claims.text:
**The Diamond Sutra (Vajracchedikā)**
The *Diamond Sūtra* is a prominent Mahāyāna sutra within the Chan/Zen tradition.
The most famous physical copy is a Tang dynasty Chinese version dated to May **11**, **868**.
This woodblock-printed book was found among the Dunhuang manuscripts in **1900** by Daoist monk Wang Yuanlu and sold to Aurel Stein in **1907**.
It holds the distinction of being the earliest dated printed book and contains an explicit public domain dedication stating it was created for universal free distribution [estate-1].
